name: m4-t4-weak-vs-direct

variantDescriptions.weak-t4: today's `WeakHashSet` uniques table (cleared per run, retronym/scala#244); 4 concurrent compiles, each thread a new `Global` per op
variantDescriptions.direct-t4: retronym/scala#252's lossy direct-mapped `Array[Type]` (16K slots, fresh array every 64K inserts); 4 concurrent compiles

description: Quick check: does the lossy direct-mapped table's GC advantage over today's weak table (job 690, one compile at a time, m5-pro: −17% pause, −5% wall) grow when 4 compiles share one heap, as in sbt building modules in parallel? JMH `-t 4`, scala corpus, 16 GB default-sized G1 heap, M4. Score is ms per compile per thread.
Build `claude/direct-mapped-uniques-chunked` `630ab4c95e`, interner picked per fork by `-Dscalac.uniques`.
